title: 11 police personnel, 15 militants killed in overnight attack in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
summary_full: A major militant attack occurred overnight on a police post in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. Eleven police personnel and fifteen attackers died during the fierce exchange of gunfire. The Khazina police post in Hangu district was the target of this significant assault. Security forces fought back, killing the militants and repelling the attack. This incident highlights the ongoing rise in militant violence in the region.
